title: changed regex placeholder text
description: Hi Garrick. Just a small suggestion and of course feel free to blow off (or modify), but I would find it helpful to have a _specific warning_ in the regex placeholder text that I need a single backslash as an escape character instead of a double slash. I know it's in the help file, but even those of us who might have read the help file when first installing the add-in could forget about needing a single backslash a few months later. "Standard RegEx" and the example probably _should have_ been enough to jog my memory but wasn't.  Wish I could have coded an additional feature adding a checkbox for "use double slash" or "use single slash" but couldn't quite figure out how to do that after reading the code, sorry!

title: Words "not" added for clarity.
description: As these are three separate regular expressions (`\W` `\D` `\S`), so I suggest adding "not" before each explanation to stress their meaning.
